payload.title: Specs: Gherkin + property tests + collision fixtures for dynamic IDs
payload.description: Gherkin scenarios are source of truth; both Rust and Python CLIs pass the same specs. Replace exact 6-char fixtures (features/issues/issue_key_representation.feature, test_ids_text_editor_templates.py, id_format_steps, issue_key_steps, compatibility_steps, discovery_steps). Property tests: injectivity, minimality, determinism. Fixtures: 4-char collision, local-vs-shared, dotted sub-ID, widened past 8 (hyphen case), beads IDs, numeric IDs, unicode custom IDs. Shared JSON fixtures for Rust/Py/TS.
